mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_job_recommendation ( id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, member_id BIGINT NOT NULL, job_id BIGINT NOT NULL, total_score INT NOT NULL, job_score INT NOT NULL, region_score INT NOT NULL, employment_score INT NOT NULL, career_score INT NOT NULL, salary_score INT NOT NULL, work_style_score INT NOT NULL, accessibility_score INT NOT NULL, recommendation_reason VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, mismatch_reason VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uk_ai_recommendation_member_job UNIQUE (member_id, job_id), CONSTRAINT fk_ai_recommendation_member FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES member(id), CONSTRAINT fk_ai_recommendation_job FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES interest_job(id) )
mapper.select: SELECT member_id, desired_job, desired_region, employment_type, career_type, career_years, min_salary, remote_preferred, flexible_preferred, wheelchair_required, accessible_restroom_required, disabled_parking_required, assistive_device_required FROM job_seeker_profile WHERE member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT id, member_id, company_name, title, job_category, employment_type, location, salary_min, salary_max, experience_level, education_level, description, requirements, preferred_qualifications, accessibility_info, wheelchair_accessible, accessible_restroom, disabled_parking, remote_available, flexible_work_available, assistive_device_support, deadline, status, created_at, updated_at FROM interest_job WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND (deadline IS NULL OR deadline >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY deadline IS NULL, deadline, id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_job_recommendation SET total_score = #{totalScore}, job_score = #{jobScore}, region_score = #{regionScore}, employment_score = #{employmentTypeScore}, career_score = #{careerScore}, salary_score = #{salaryScore}, work_style_score = #{workStyleScore}, accessibility_score = #{accessibilityScore}, recommendation_reason = #{recommendationReason}, mismatch_reason = #{mismatchReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND job_id = #{jobId}
